candidate_attempt_rule: Five candidate slots are shared across all K targets. Each may use at most one new real tactical CLI and one fixed full-stage simulation. Contract or static failures retain the slot; only STARTED processes and simulations count against their applicable limits.
counting_rule: Count each real tactical CLI process and each fixed full-stage simulation at STARTED, including failures and timeouts. A WIN freezes that candidate, updates best N, and sets the next K=N-1; continue only while total M76 slots remain. No automatic retry, resume, replacement call, historical balance transfer, or sixth candidate.
service_failure_stop_rule: If a started real CLI returns capacity, usage limit, HTTP 403, or routing failure with no tactical output, archive it and stop starting further M76 CLI calls this session while preserving unused budget for later recovery.
